hmr_li_2_customer_reply.subject: Battery return handling for RMA-2026-604
hmr_li_2_customer_reply.body: Thank you for the details on RMA-2026-604. Stop using and charging the PowerCell L48 battery. Do not bend, puncture, compress, place it in household trash, or try to remove it. If this can be done without handling the battery, keep the device away from combustible materials on a noncombustible surface in a ventilated area. If it smokes, hisses, leaks, or becomes hotter, move away, call local emergency services, and do not re-enter. Do not mail, courier, drop off, or box the battery. Our Hazardous Materials Returns team will confirm an approved carrier, packaging, or local disposal route before any transport.
